theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpf_current_of_bounded_functional
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T₀ : TestFormOn U n → ℝ) (B : ℝ), (∀ ω η : TestFormOn U n, T₀ (ω + η) = T₀ ω + T₀ η) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), T₀ (c • ω) = c * T₀ ω) → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn U n) (C : ℝ), (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) y) ≤ C) → |T₀ ω| ≤ B * C) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω, S ω = T₀ ω) ∧ S.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
